description: This file declares structures and functions related to undoing or resolving undo operations within a Git index, specifically for resolving unmerge or conflict situations.

methods.name: record_resolve_undo
methods.description: Records an undo state for a given cache entry in the index.

methods.name: resolve_undo_write
methods.description: Serializes undo information into a strbuf, possibly for saving to disk.

methods.name: resolve_undo_read
methods.description: Reconstructs undo information from stored data.

methods.name: resolve_undo_clear_index
methods.description: Clears undo information from the index.

methods.name: unmerge_index_entry
methods.description: Applies undo to a specific index entry, unmerging it if necessary.

methods.name: unmerge_index
methods.description: Unmerges multiple index entries based on pathspec.
